differences.a_observable: Vibrant blue and yellow blocks surround the white 'Secure Payments' block.
differences.b_observable: The surrounding blocks are flat gray, lacking the blue and yellow colors.
differences.fix: Apply the correct blue and yellow materials to the surrounding blocks.

differences.a_observable: The grid of dots is located on the left side of the vertical stack of blocks.
differences.b_observable: The grid of dots is located on the right side of the vertical stack of blocks.

differences.a_observable: Crevices between the blocks have deep, dark shadows.
differences.b_observable: Crevices between the blocks are brightly lit with very soft shadows.
differences.fix: Darken the contact shadows and increase ambient occlusion.
